name: Shadowglen
summary: Shadowglen is where young night elves begin their training, beneath the boughs of Teldrassil. The whole vale gathers around Aldrassil, a great hollow tree. Inside it, elders, priestesses and mentors guide the young. Only then do they travel farther into the world.

sections.title: A Sheltered Cradle
sections.body: Aldrassil is a vast barrow-tree, and it rises in a vale of eternal dusk. The glen lies under the northeastern boughs of the World Tree, and high ridges ring it round. A single narrow pass leads south, toward Starbreeze Village and Dolanaar. With only one way out, the glen stays sheltered and at peace.

sections.title: Creeping Shadows
sections.body: Yet danger reaches even here. In the far northwest lies Shadowthread Cave, and its venomous spiders threaten the glade. So the young defenders drive them back, along with the vermin and the wild beasts. Then they venture on, deeper among Teldrassil's boughs.

faq.answer: Shadowglen is where young night elves begin their training in northeastern Teldrassil. In the vale, elders, priestesses, and mentors guide them beneath the great barrow-tree Aldrassil.

faq.q: What is the massive tree at the center of the glen?
faq.answer: Aldrassil is the barrow-tree at the heart of Shadowglen. Its hollowed trunk houses elders, priestesses, and mentors who guide young night elves in training.
Venomous spiders in Shadowthread Cave threaten Shadowglen from the extreme northwest. Young defenders also face untamed wildlife in the glade.
A narrow mountain pass leads south out of Shadowglen toward Starbreeze Village and Dolanaar. With only one way out, the glen stays sheltered from the rest of the world.

angles.text: As a night elf, you begin your training in Shadowglen beneath Aldrassil, then face the wider world beyond the vale.
As an Alliance traveler, you find Shadowglen high among Teldrassil's boughs, sheltered behind guarded ports.
